runSummary.note: Fresh 10.9.2026 13:10 sweep genuinely searched Profesia, direct company careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera.sk, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork/Freelancer, Reddit/public WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. A strong new Profesia candidate was verified: Viessmann — service-team dispatcher/coordination, Ivanska cesta 30A Bratislava-Ruzinov, 1,400 EUR + quarterly bonuses + 13th/14th salary, immediate start, occasional home office, graduate-friendly, no foreign-language requirement stated; duties are dispatching service technicians, processing service requests, maintenance planning and customer contact. It clears the location/language/skill gate but could not be persisted to jobs-data.json because the current GitHub connector only exposes a truncated representation of the large file while writes require full-file replacement; fail-closed prevented a destructive rewrite. Asseco CEIT — autonomous-robot technician is technically attractive and §21 is only an advantage, but work is stated to occur directly at customer sites without a sufficiently clear travel geography, so locationEligibility remains unknown pending verification. LinkedIn support hits remain B2/C1/fluent-English rejects. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable hiring posts; coverage remains limited.
